title: Hinomori Shizuku — Careful Stitching〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Phew... I think I'm finally starting to get the hang of this dance...

Hello, Shizuku!
You seem to be practicing very hard.
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Here, take this drink.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's good that you're working hard, but you've been at it for quite a while now. Remember that it's important to take breaks from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, you're right...
I didn't realize what time it was.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think I will call it a day here. I wouldn't want to feel so fatigued that I end up running late tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Do you have plans tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, it's my first day off in quite a while.
I promised a friend who loves to sew that we'd go to the sewing lounge together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They have all these sewing machines available for rental, as well as a wide assortment of other equipment. I've been there a number of times already to do embroidery.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I didn't know such a place existed...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but I'm always a little worried about getting lost along the way. I still haven't been able to fully commit how to get there to memory...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Fortunately, my friend suggested that we head there together after finding out that we'd be going on the same day.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um, Shizuku? Would it be possible for me to watch you embroider? But you don't have to let me if you feel uncomfortable...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm just curious as to what this sewing lounge you speak of is actually like.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, well... It shouldn't be a problem as long as you stay hidden.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll call you over when I think it's safe, so if you don't mind waiting until then...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I'll be looking forward to hearing from you!
Sewing Lounge

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Here we are!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mizuki.
I wouldn't have been able to get here without you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're welcome!
Anyway, I'm gonna go grab a sewing machine.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course.
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Now should be fine...
Miku, KAITO, are you two there?

rows.Speaker: Miku & KAITO
rows.Line:
<Yes!>
<Present.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank goodness.
So, let's see... I'll move the case towards the edge of the table, and place my phone under it...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay, it seems well hidden.
Can you two see me okay...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, we can see you just fine!>
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, there we are... It's all set up!
Now, let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, let's both do our best to make some cute creations, shall we?
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wow...! That flower only took you a few seconds to—>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... Hey, Shizuku, mind taking a look at this ribbon for me?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hm? It seems very cute...
Is something wrong with it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm having trouble getting it to look just right. I wanted to give it more of a cartoonish feel... But what do you think?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: More of a cartoonish feel...? Then, what if you paired it with some of the fabrics over here that you brought over?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<I see...
That would help make it look more colorful. I'm impressed, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <KAITO! Shh!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Mizuki
rows.Line: It's finished!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Your embroidery's so cute, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Your ribbon is also lovely, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And I have you to thank!
I really appreciate the advice you gave me!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, lemme go give this sewing machine back!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course.
se_walk_women_002_3

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What did you think, you two?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<I learned so much!
I'm going to try making alterations to some of our outfits using the things I saw today.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I was amazed by how quickly you two could make such cute things. It felt like magic...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you both enjoyed everything so much.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<We really did!
Thank you so much for allowing us to watch today, Shizuku.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Anyway, we'll see you again in SEKAI!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, see you later.
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting.
Let's start heading out!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku, are you doing anything after this?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, I'm off work today, so I don't have any plans...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really? Then, wanna get in some shopping since we still have some time?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's this handicrafts shop that I've really been wanting to check out with you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds wonderful! I'd love to go.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Great! In that case... Let's go♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It feels like it's been so long since I had a chance to go shopping with a friend...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Thanks to Mizuki, I'm getting to have such a wonderful time on my day off.)
